Dadle – Services for better depression care

OND Lab & New Design Studio Seoju Yun, Donghyeok Yoo, Dongjun Choe, Seungho Park-Lee & Hwang Kim Posted on June 3, 2022

‹DADLE› is a platform designed to help users overcome depression through online group therapy and interactive activities. By analyzing a user’s psychological test results and preferences, the platform matches them with groups facing similar challenges and therapists with relevant expertise.

Group therapy sessions are conducted via video chat while preserving anonymity by using customizable character avatars instead of real faces.

These sessions, combined with various group activities, enhance the benefits of group therapy—such as empathy, comfort, and bonding—while addressing the stigma around depression and its treatment, which remains prevalent in South Korea.

‹다들(DADLE)›은 온라인 그룹 치료를 비롯한 여러 활동을 통해 사용자가 우울증을 극복할 수 있도록 돕는 플랫폼이다. 플랫폼은 전문 상담사와 비슷한 어려움을 겪는 사람들을 연결하여 우울증 치료 효과를 개선한다. 집단치료 세션은 캐릭터를 이용하여 익명성을 유지한 화상채팅으로 진행된다. 또한 다양한 그룹 활동을 통해 참여자들 간의 공감, 위안, 유대감 등을 극대화하여 그룹 치료의 이점을 강화한다.

Idea

‹DADLE› aims to make group therapy more accessible and effective by connecting users with the right groups and therapists. It eliminates traditional barriers like time, location, and the discomfort of face-to-face meetings, allowing users to experience the healing power of empathy and support.

Form

Purple, often associated with depression, has been reimagined as ‹DADLE›’s identity color to reduce stigma and create a welcoming environment. The service includes friendly illustrations and personalized content tailored to each user’s situation, making the platform approachable and easy to use.

Function

The platform provides professional psychological tests that guide the therapy process. An AI system recommends therapists and group members tailored to the user’s specific needs, with additional options for personalized group preferences.

Differentiation

‹DADLE› stands out by using AI to enhance therapy effectiveness. For therapists, it analyzes group activities and emotional states, suggesting relevant counseling topics. For users, it tracks and manages their emotional and physical health, offering tips for improvement.

Impact

The stigma surrounding depression often prevents people from seeking help. ‹DADLE› breaks this barrier by creating a safe, supportive space for therapy and reinforcing the message that depression is a shared struggle that can be resolved through community and care.
